integrity: A written self-contained mathematical proof and reproducible finite symbolic checks are supplied. All status fields identify self-review only; no independent audit or publication is asserted.
limitations: The assertion covers finite cyclic shifts with exactly two distinguished positive weights; it does not establish all-weight permutation inclusion.
No explicit lower bound for the strict support-function gap is claimed.
Bibliographic priority is subject to inaccessible historic full texts and potential stronger spectral rearrangement theorems.
Symbolic and finite numerical tests support, but cannot replace, the analytic all-dimensional proof.
title: Strict numerical-range nesting for two-defect cyclic shifts
